title: Recycling Active QNodes in Spinlocks
pattern: Immediately recycling or freeing a thread's queue node (QNode) during a CLH or MCS spinlock release before verifying that no subsequent threads hold references to it.
why_bad: A slow contending thread might have read the tail pointer and holds a reference to the releasing thread's QNode, but has not yet written the `next` link. Freeing the node immediately leads to a use-after-free and pointer corruption when the slow thread finally writes to `q->next`.
detection: A queue-based spinlock (MCS or CLH) that recycles/frees nodes inside the unlock path without utilizing a reclamation delay, epoch, or successor hand-off check.
counterexample: Spinning on the successor's arrival to guarantee it has completed its link before recycling.
